description: This file defines the OrganizationDao class, which manages database interactions for organization information within the OrangeHRM system. It includes methods for retrieving and saving organization data and updating organizational structure entities, indicating it's part of the data access layer.

classes.name: OrganizationDao
classes.description: Data Access Object for managing Organization entities, providing methods to retrieve and update organization information and structure within the database.

methods.name: getOrganizationGeneralInformation
methods.description: Retrieve the main Organization record (ID=1) from the database, returning null if not found.

methods.name: saveOrganizationGeneralInformation
methods.description: Save the provided Organization object to the database within a transaction, updating the organizational structure accordingly.

methods.name: updateOrganizationStructure
methods.description: Update the base organizational unit's name to match the Organization's name.
